item.title: Reticular Activating System
item.description: Sleep-wake transitions, wakefulness, and motor functions are controlled by a part of the midbrain called the reticular activating system (RAS) When we are wakeful and conscious, the neurons in the RAS engage in low-voltage burst firing (several neurons fire off at low voltages continuously).

item.title: Subjective Threshold
item.description: Subjective Threshold in Subliminal Perception is the minimum threshold at which stimuli are consciously perceived.

item.title: BIOS Interrupt Calls
item.description: BIOS interrupt calls are software interrupts that an OS or a bootloader uses to request specific services/processes from the BIOS.
